title: Micro Bolus Represented by SBM Marker
body:
Recently SMB markers were introduced to nightlies, for small boluses to reduce clutter on the xDrip timeline for looping users.

This is currently the default, even for non looping users, impacting boluses <=0.3u.

Request that this visual be able to be disabled so that users micro bolusing can still track their dose.

Edit: Threshold from 0.5 to <=0.3

![screenshot_20180826-101858_xdrip](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/25760491/44623476-a27f4780-a923-11e8-8ceb-b396add45ac8.jpg)

comments.body: The issue report is for boluses < 0.5 but it should only affect boluses <= 0.3U - Can you confirm?

Request is to be able to disable the graphic for any bolus be it 0.1, 0.3 or 0.5.

But yeah just tested now and you are quite right. Only 0.3 and below is currently affected I'll edit the original post.
Interesting the toast says 0.5 in the screen shot :)
@jamorham... Also think I found a bug. Entering 0.299U results in 99U being registered.
Yep, I think these are two different issues. I will get them addressed.
Please try the 27th Aug nightly, see the new setting in `xDrip+ display settings`

Seems good. Tested with 0.2, got icon, changed setting, icon turned to value. Worked in reverse :) I wasn't able to reproduce any toast at all for min bolus.

I'll close this issue and open a new one for the rounding bug above.
